judged_text: store.js.es6 plural branch leaves null entries in the hydrated array for unresolved ids

record.issue_text: store.js.es6 plural branch leaves null entries in the hydrated array for unresolved ids

adjudication.rationale: In store.js.es6, the new plural hydration branch handles keys matching /(.+)\_id(s?)$/ where m[2] indicates a plural "_ids". It does `const hydrated = obj[k].map(id => self._lookupSubType(...))` and then assigns `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = hydrated || []`. Since `Array#map` always returns an array, `hydrated || []` will never fall back to `[]`, and any unresolved id for which `_lookupSubType` returns null/undefined will remain as a null/undefined entry in the resulting array (no filtering/compaction is done). This is a real, diff-introduced correctness issue compared to the singular branch which only assigns when a hydrated object is present.
